description: This Java class implements the CommandStrategy for updating client information in the Fineract platform. It processes batch requests to update client details via ClientsApiResource and constructs BatchResponse objects with the outcome.

classes.name: UpdateClientCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy to handle batch update requests for clients, utilizing ClientsApiResource to perform updates and responding with BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to update a client; extracts client ID from URL, calls the ClientsApiResource.update method, and constructs a BatchResponse with status and body.
